description: Implement the sequential entry model, MT5 connector, risk management, Telegram notifications, trade logger, and backtesting engine
steps: Create ict_bot/entry_model.py: Implement the sequential confirmation entry model that enforces strict ordering during Kill Zones. State machine with states: WAITING_FOR_SWEEP -> WAITING_FOR_MSS -> WAITING_FOR_FVG -> READY_TO_ENTER. Class EntryModel with methods: update(candle_data) that processes each new candle, check_liquidity_sweep() using liquidity module, check_mss() using market_structure module (only after sweep detected), check_fvg() using fvg module (only after MSS detected), generate_entry_signal() that returns entry parameters (entry_price at FVG 50% midpoint, stop_loss above/below the candle that created the HIGHEST FVG in the MSS leg, take_profit at opposing liquidity). Reset state after entry or kill zone ends.

Create ict_bot/risk_management.py: Calculate position size based on 1% risk per trade and stop loss distance. Track daily P&L and enforce 3% max daily loss. Functions: calculate_position_size(account_balance, risk_percent, entry_price, stop_loss_price, symbol_info), check_daily_loss_limit(daily_pnl, account_balance, max_loss_percent=0.03), can_take_trade(daily_pnl, account_balance). Also validate that stop loss and take profit levels are logical.

Create ict_bot/mt5_connector.py: Wrapper around MetaTrader5 package. Class MT5Connector with methods: connect(login, password, server), disconnect(), get_candles(symbol, timeframe, count), get_account_info(), place_order(symbol, order_type, volume, price, sl, tp, comment), close_position(ticket), get_open_positions(), get_symbol_info(symbol). Handle connection errors gracefully. Timeframe mapping from string (M1, M15, H4, D1) to MT5 constants.

Create ict_bot/telegram_notifier.py: Send trade alerts and daily summaries via Telegram Bot API. Class TelegramNotifier with methods: send_alert(message), send_trade_entry(trade_details), send_trade_exit(trade_result), send_daily_summary(daily_stats). Format messages with relevant trade info (entry, SL, TP, risk, R:R ratio). Use python-telegram-bot or direct HTTP requests to Telegram API.

Create ict_bot/logger.py: Trade journal logging system. Log all trade decisions, entries, exits, and analysis results. Class TradeLogger with methods: log_analysis(timeframe, analysis_type, result), log_trade_entry(trade_details), log_trade_exit(trade_result), log_daily_summary(). Write to both console and file (logs/ directory). Include timestamps, trade rationale, ICT concepts triggered.

Create ict_bot/backtester.py: Backtesting engine that replays historical data through the entry model. Class Backtester with methods: load_data(csv_file_or_mt5_history), run(start_date, end_date), get_results(). Simulate the full entry model on historical 1m data within kill zone windows. Track metrics: win rate, average R:R, profit factor, max drawdown, total trades, equity curve. Output results as a summary dict and optionally save to CSV.

Update main.py: Create the main trading loop. Load config from YAML. Initialize MT5 connector, Telegram notifier, logger. Multi-timeframe analysis loop: fetch HTF (D1/H4) for bias, MTF (M15) for context/zones, LTF (1m) for entry. During kill zones, run the entry model. Place trades via MT5 when signals fire. Support --backtest flag to run backtester instead of live trading. Support --config flag to specify config file path.
acceptance_criteria: EntryModel enforces sequential state: sweep -> MSS -> FVG -> entry. Cannot skip steps.
Risk management correctly calculates position size: for $10000 account with 1% risk and 50 pip SL, position size should be appropriate
MT5Connector has all required methods with proper error handling and does not crash if MT5 is not installed (graceful import handling)
TelegramNotifier formats trade messages with entry, SL, TP, R:R ratio
TradeLogger writes structured logs to both file and console
Backtester can process a list of OHLC candles and produce trade statistics
main.py is executable and handles --backtest and --config CLI arguments

All modules import cleanly: python -c 'from ict_bot.entry_model import EntryModel; from ict_bot.risk_management import calculate_position_size; from ict_bot.mt5_connector import MT5Connector; from ict_bot.telegram_notifier import TelegramNotifier; from ict_bot.backtester import Backtester'
verification: python -c 'from ict_bot.entry_model import EntryModel; from ict_bot.risk_management import calculate_position_size, check_daily_loss_limit; from ict_bot.mt5_connector import MT5Connector; from ict_bot.telegram_notifier import TelegramNotifier; from ict_bot.logger import TradeLogger; from ict_bot.backtester import Backtester; print("All imports OK")'
python main.py --help || python main.py --backtest --config config/config_example.yaml 2>&1 | head -20

python -m py_compile ict_bot/entry_model.py && python -m py_compile ict_bot/risk_management.py && python -m py_compile ict_bot/mt5_connector.py && python -m py_compile ict_bot/telegram_notifier.py && python -m py_compile ict_bot/logger.py && python -m py_compile ict_bot/backtester.py
